name: Bauer Fabrication & Art Metal
old_description: At Bauer Fabrication & Art Metal based in Waterbury, VT, we take pride in the artistic execution of our customers’ projects. Our fabrication work is custom art, aesthetic as well as utilitarian. Dedicated to the realization of our clients’ unique specifications, we pay extra attention to detail, thereby creating one-of-a-kind pieces.
about:
Bauer Fabrication & Art Metal operates from Waterbury, Vermont, where a team of metal fabrication artisans and engineers led by Eric produces custom architectural metalwork, furniture, and sculptural pieces. The shop emphasizes traditional hand-and-eye techniques alongside a patented thermal-spray process developed in-house.

The company fabricates stair rails, staircases, memorials, sinks, garden fences, and household objects such as customized cookware and floral displays. Work is performed in a Waterbury facility using both conventional metalworking methods and the proprietary "Bauer Art Metal" process, which sprays molten metal onto wire mesh to create freestanding forms that would otherwise require casting. Design services and installation are offered, and the shop coordinates with architects and contractors to deliver finished pieces.

Clients include architects, designers, contractors, and homeowners primarily in the construction and architectural markets. While most installations are in Vermont, the firm has completed projects in New York City, Boston, Florida, Mississippi, California, and the U.S. Virgin Islands.

The business distinguishes itself through its patented thermal-spray technique, a commitment to artisan-level detail on one-of-a-kind commissions, and a willingness to take on challenging, non-standard jobs that combine aesthetic and utilitarian requirements.
